metadata.description: Reference Skills, routines and phone helpers for small businesses: customer replies, bookings, follow-ups, getting paid on time, finding clients, a one-page shop, Google visibility, posts and reels, a sales plan across channels, staff checklists, stock checks and returns, hiring, and making your own helper.

plugins.name: start-here
plugins.description: Not sure yet? Find one job AI can help with this week.

plugins.name: customer-replies
plugins.description: AI drafts the routine replies in your tone for you to check and send. You write only the ones that need you.

plugins.name: booking-reminders
plugins.description: Confirmation and reminder messages that tell customers exactly what to do.

plugins.name: follow-ups
plugins.description: A polite 3-step follow-up, a daily "who to message today" list, and an end-of-day report.

plugins.name: get-paid
plugins.description: Friendly payment reminders and a simple list, with no money details in the AI.

plugins.name: find-clients
plugins.description: Turn your best customers into a clear picture of who to look for, where, and what to say.

plugins.name: one-page-shop
plugins.description: One link for everything you offer, with a clear button for each: buy, book or ask.

plugins.name: get-found-on-google
plugins.description: A complete Google profile, the right words, and steps to earn genuine reviews.

plugins.name: staff-checklists
plugins.description: Clear opening, closing and daily checklists for each role, so work runs without you.

plugins.name: stock-and-returns
plugins.description: A monthly routine for expiry checks and supplier returns, with each step assigned and timed.

plugins.name: hire-and-onboard
plugins.description: Job posts that bring the right people, fewer drop-offs, and a calm first week.

plugins.name: social-posts
plugins.description: A week of posts and captions in your voice, with photo ideas you can shoot yourself.

plugins.name: sales-plan
plugins.description: A month-by-month plan for selling to businesses, direct on WhatsApp and through posts, with a bank of post ideas.

plugins.name: make-your-own
plugins.description: Turn one job you do every week into your own helper, then test it in five minutes.
